19

21	open import Classical.Structures.Group.Subgroups     using ( IsSubgroup )
22	open import Classical.Structures.Group.Conjugation   using ( module Conjugate )
23	open import Setoid.Algebras.Basic                    using ( 𝕌[_] ; 𝔻[_] )
24	open import Classical.Structures.Group.Complexes     using ( module Complex )
25	open import Classical.Structures.Group.Cosets        using ( module Coset )
26	
27	module _ {α ρ ℓ : Level} (𝒢 : Group α ρ)
28	  (H : Pred 𝕌[ proj₁ 𝒢 ] ℓ) (H-sub : IsSubgroup 𝒢 H)
29	  (K : Pred 𝕌[ proj₁ 𝒢 ] ℓ) (K-sub : IsSubgroup 𝒢 K) (K-normal : Conjugate.IsNormal 𝒢 K)
30	  where
31	  private
32	    𝑮 = proj₁ 𝒢
33	    G = 𝕌[ 𝑮 ]
34	
35	  -- The intersection, with its subgroup proof (provided, not to be proved here).
36	  H∩K : Pred G ℓ
37	  H∩K x = x ∈ H × x ∈ K
38	
39	  H∩K-sub : IsSubgroup 𝒢 H∩K
40	  H∩K-sub = record
41	    { respects      = λ x≈y (x∈H , x∈K) → IsSubgroup.respects H-sub x≈y x∈H , IsSubgroup.respects K-sub x≈y x∈K
42	    ; isSubuniverse = λ f a im → IsSubgroup.isSubuniverse H-sub f a (λ i → proj₁ (im i))
43	                                , IsSubgroup.isSubuniverse K-sub f a (λ i → proj₂ (im i))
44	    }
45	
46	  open Coset 𝒢 H∩K H∩K-sub using () renaming ( _∼_ to _∼ᴴ∩ᴷ_ )
47	  open Coset 𝒢 K   K-sub   using () renaming ( _∼_ to _∼ᴷ_ )
48	
49	  second-iso-cosets-agree
50	    :  ∀ {h₁ h₂} → h₁ ∈ H → h₂ ∈ H → (h₁ ∼ᴴ∩ᴷ h₂ → h₁ ∼ᴷ h₂) × (h₁ ∼ᴷ h₂ → h₁ ∼ᴴ∩ᴷ h₂)
51	  second-iso-cosets-agree h₁∈H h₂∈H = {!!}
